description: Blocks vulnerability-scanner / credential-probe 404 noise at the Cloudflare edge so it never reaches the autoplans.dev origin. Edge copy of infra/nginx-block-404-noise.conf semantics for the case where raw scanner requests never see a CAAS/origin reverse proxy.
deployment: PUT /zones/{zone_id}/rulesets/phases/http_request_firewall_custom/entrypoint with this as the body. In the dashboard this is Security > WAF > Custom rules > Create rule. First deploy with action:"log" for a watch window, then flip to "block". 'block' answers Cloudflare's own 403 block page at the edge; the probe never reaches the origin and never becomes a NotFound telemetry event.

rules.expression: (any(lower(http.request.uri.path), lower(http.request.uri.path) matches ".*\\.(zip|rar|7z|tar|tgz|bz2|xz|sql(\\.gz)?|sqlite|sqlite3|db|bak|old|backup|dump|orig|save|tmp)$")) or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/backup") or lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^/(db|database)(\\.|$)" or any(lower(http.request.uri.path), lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^(configs?|settings|application|environment|local|web)\\.(json|js|yaml|yml|py|php|ini|conf|config|env|txt|xml)$") or any(lower(http.request.uri.path), lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^(appsettings[^/]*\\.json|local\\.settings\\.json|web\\.config)$") or lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^/(config|emails)/[^/]*\\.(js|json|py|php|env|yaml|yml|ini|conf)$"
rules.description: Archive/database/config-dump files (any depth, extension-based): *.zip *.tar* *.sql* *.sqlite *.db *.bak *.old *.backup, /db*, /database*, /backup*, settings/config/env dump-shaped files. Mirrors the nginx map extension and dump rules.

rules.expression: (any(lower(http.request.uri.path), lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^\\.(env(\\.[a-z0-9_-]+)?|htpasswd|htaccess|netrc|npmrc|s3cfg|pgpass|my\\.cnf|pem|key|p12|pfx|jks|keystore)$")) or lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^/env(\\.|$)" or any(lower(http.request.uri.path), lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^(id_rsa|id_dsa|id_ecdsa|id_ed25519)$") or any(lower(http.request.uri.path), lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^(credentials[^/]*\\.json|service[_-]?account[^/]*\\.json|secrets?\\.[a-z0-9]+|terraform\\.(tfstate|tfvars))$") or any(lower(http.request.uri.path), lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^\\.(git|svn|hg)$") or lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^/\\.git/" or any(lower(http.request.uri.path), lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^[^/]+[~]$") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".swp")
rules.description: Credential dotfiles / secret key material and text-editor droppings: .env variants, /env.*, .git access, ssh keys, keystores, terraform state, config~ / *.swp.

rules.expression: starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp") or any(lower(http.request.uri.path), lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^(wp-json|xmlrpc\\.php)$") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/livewire") or lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^/(telescope|_debugbar|_profiler|horizon|nova|pulse|phpinfo)(/|$)" or lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^/actuator(/|$)" or lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^/(owa|ecp|autodiscover|exchange|phpmyadmin|pma|cgi-bin|aspnet_client|webdav)(/|$)" or lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^/(graphql|gql|graphiql)(/|$)" or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/swagger") or lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^/openapi(\\.|_)" or lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^/api-docs(/|$)" or lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^/(_cat|elasticsearch|kibana|logstash)(/|$)" or lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^/v2/_catalog(/|$)" or lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^/server$" or lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^/tasting(/|$)" or lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^/api/?$" or lower(http.request.uri.path) matches "^/api/(env|config|keys?|secret|credential)"
rules.description: Probes for software this site does not run: WordPress, livewire, Laravel debug tooling, Spring actuator, Exchange/O365, phpMyAdmin, GraphQL, Swagger/OpenAPI, Elasticsearch, plus observed probe paths /server /tasting /api and /api/<secret-ish>. Bare /api is not blocked with a trailing segment so real /api/* routes survive; /api/csp-report, /api/v1/* and /docs stay live.

rules.expression: (any(http.user_agent, lower(http.user_agent) contains "sqlmap")) or (any(http.user_agent, lower(http.user_agent) contains "nikto")) or (any(http.user_agent, lower(http.user_agent) contains "nuclei")) or (any(http.user_agent, lower(http.user_agent) contains "wpscan")) or (any(http.user_agent, lower(http.user_agent) contains "masscan")) or (any(http.user_agent, lower(http.user_agent) contains "zgrab")) or (any(http.user_agent, lower(http.user_agent) contains "nessus")) or (any(http.user_agent, lower(http.user_agent) contains "openvas")) or (any(http.user_agent, lower(http.user_agent) contains "acunetix")) or (any(http.user_agent, lower(http.user_agent) contains "netsparker")) or (any(http.user_agent, lower(http.user_agent) contains "arachni")) or (any(http.user_agent, lower(http.user_agent) contains "w3af")) or (any(http.user_agent, lower(http.user_agent) contains "nmap")) or (any(http.user_agent, lower(http.user_agent) contains "metasploit")) or (any(http.user_agent, lower(http.user_agent) contains "wfuzz")) or (any(http.user_agent, lower(http.user_agent) contains "gobuster")) or (any(http.user_agent, lower(http.user_agent) contains "dirbuster")) or (any(lower(http.user_agent), lower(http.user_agent) contains "joomlavs")) or (any(lower(http.user_agent), lower(http.user_agent) contains "plecost"))
rules.description: Scanner/exploit-framework User-Agents (sqlmap, nikto, nuclei, wpscan, masscan, zgrab, nessus, openvas, acunetix, netsparker, arachni, w3af, nmap, metasploit, wfuzz, gobuster, dirbuster, joomlavs, plecost). Deliberately narrow - generic UAs (curl, Go-http-client, python-requests) are never blocked on UA alone.

encoded_variant_note: WAF expression matching sees the request path percent-encoded. Rules 1-3 match the decoded-looking lower(http.request.uri.path) form Cloudflare evaluates; for double-encoded / %2e / %2f leftovers that slip through, add the managed rules 'Block requests with known bad bot behavior' or an extra rule matching http.request.uri against (%2e|%252e|%2f|cannot)
origin_layer_note: Keep infra/nginx-block-404-noise.conf + the vhost patch for the origin's own reverse proxy as defense in depth behind Cloudflare. The edge rules do the heavy lifting since every scanner request transits CF first.
